## Which layer it belongs to

<!-- The family is strictly layered: parser (formats and data model) →
     store (storage and the match interface) → sparql / shacl. A capability
     usually belongs to the lowest layer that can provide it. If you are
     asking a downstream project for something the store should expose,
     say so — that is a store issue with a consumer's evidence attached. -->
